azapi_resource.diag_settings sends diagnostic logs to the management Log Analytics workspace using workspaceId = local.template_file_variables.log_analytics_workspace_resource_id, which is a plain ID string derived from module.management_resources outputs (no resource reference). Consequently nothing orders the diagnostic settings after azurerm_log_analytics_workspace.management. When both deploy_diagnostics_for_mg and deploy_management_resources are enabled, the settings can be created before the workspace exists, causing an apply-time failure. It should depend on azurerm_log_analytics_workspace.management.
